title: Realty Income, Macro, and Bitcoin Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Liquidity, bitcoin adoption, and net-lease valuation.
coverage_note: Read all blocks and image inventory. Covered macro, China, bitcoin cycle, Realty Income and gold; excluded routine allocations and disclaimers.

claims.reason: New issuance is only one source of tradable coins. The stock can transact repeatedly; price clears willingness to buy and sell, so comparing ETF demand only with mined supply is incomplete.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Narrow deductive identity only; no empirical forecasting credit.

assumptions: Positive holder willingness to sell at some prices
proof.derivation: Available sell flow at price p equals newly issued coins offered plus existing inventory offered; issuance is therefore not an upper bound on market supply.

evidence.title: 2024 central-bank gold survey
evidence.finding: Central banks added 1,037 tonnes in 2023 after 1,082 tonnes in 2022. Survey of 70 respondents conducted February-April 2024: 29% planned higher own gold reserves. Motives included strategic rebalancing, domestic production, crisis and inflation risk; survey intentions are not completed purchases.
